about_the_game:
The Explorer is a peaceful space exploration game with no combat.
Your mission: visit mysterious planets, gather resources, and uncover forgotten artifacts. Each planet holds a unique story that only you can reveal. There are no enemies, no weapons—just discovery, curiosity, and observation.
The game offers a fast start, with no forced tutorial: you land directly on a random planet and begin exploring its secrets at your own pace.

Gather, build, understand.
Explore local flora to collect rare plants, analyze them, and craft medicine or food. Extract fossil or alien DNA, study your samples, and gather knowledge to unlock new technologies.
Twelve different minerals are scattered across the galaxy—mine them to produce essential materials for crafting and building bases.
Roam across planets to discover hundreds of unique artifacts, each revealing a piece of history.
From the Ark, your mothership, you can mine asteroids, scan space anomalies, and much more. Every discovery expands your scientific arsenal and opens new paths for exploration.

A calm and immersive experience.
With no enemies and no pressure, the game invites you to take your time. Settle on a planet, build a base, listen to the sounds of nature, and observe the details. Every element is designed to offer a contemplative, sensory, and meaningful journey.
The Explorer is a personal adventure, where each player builds their own interpretation of the worlds they explore.
